# IGoldenHookRules.Speed property

How fast the golden hook flies: 1800 by default. On its runner's game, against another player's runner, it flies a quarter slower at most, to make up for the ping. The speed is set when the hook is shot and kept for its whole flight.

public float Speed { get; set; }
